followup.reproducible_probe_source:
import json, os, signal, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(sys.argv[1])
started = time.monotonic()
count = 0

def finish(reason):
    (root / 'finished.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(reason=reason, elapsed=time.monotonic()-started, heartbeats=count)))
    print('SYNTHETIC_FINISHED '+reason, flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0)

def cancelled(signum, frame):
    finish('SIGINT' if signum == signal.SIGINT else 'SIGTERM')

signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, cancelled)
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, cancelled)
(root / 'started.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(pid=os.getpid(), group=os.getpgrp(), tty=os.isatty(0))))
print('SYNTHETIC_STARTED', flush=True)
while time.monotonic()-started < 3:
    count += 1
    (root / 'heartbeat.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(count=count, elapsed=time.monotonic()-started)))
    time.sleep(.05)
finish('SAFETY_DEADLINE')
